newsitem.title: UK: Palm oil below highs at European veg oil close.
newsitem.headline: Palm oil below highs at European veg oil close.

text.p: Palm oil prices finished off their highs of the day at the close of the European vegetable oil market on Thursday.
Prices had been supported during the morning by higher prices in the Far East on talk that September Malaysian palm oil output would be below market expectations.
Some Far East traders felt output would not make the six percent rise forecast and could be more like three to five percent up.
However, during the afternoon European traders said the market had a softer tone with the lower Chicago opening adding to the pressure.
By the close crude palm oil was $5 to $2.50 up after Oct traded at $550 and $547.50 and Nov/Dec at $540 a tonne cif.
Among refined palm oils RBD closed $2.50 up and olein $2.50 to $5 higher with no further business reported.
Coconut oil attracted some dealer trading during the afternoon with $542.50, $545 and $547.50 paid for Sep/Oct. $735 for Oct/Nov, $730 for Nov/Dec and $722.50 for Dec/Jan.
Closing sellers were $2.50 to $7.50 higher while palmkernel oil was $7.50 to $5 higher on a tradeless market.

Buyers were active on the soft oil market with soy oil trading at 93.50 guilders for Sep/Oct while 95 guilders was paid for Nov/Jan, 97 and 97.50 for Feb/Apr and 99 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill for May/Jul.
Rape oil fetched 100 guilders for Nov/Jan and 101.75 guilders for Feb/Apr.
Closing soy oil sellers were unchanged to 0.75 guilders up and rape oil 0.50 guilders higher to unchanged.
